title: Signed tensor map on strict Roos fibres
statement: Let M be an abelian monoidal category with additive tensor, countable products, inverse-sequence limits and countable coproducts. Let A be any cochain complex in M and I,J strict tower complexes in M [def-sp-total-tensor-summand-interface, def-weil-strict-roos-model]. If b:A tensor P_I -> P_J commutes with one minus transition, the canonical tensor/cone and tensor/shift isomorphisms followed by the shifted mapping-cone map define psi:A tensor roosF(I)->roosF(J). Its two total summand coordinates are exactly SignedCoordinates(A,I,J,b,psi) [def-sfb-kflat-augmented-roos-interface]. If theta:A tensor lim I->lim J satisfies tensor(inclusion_I)b=theta inclusion_J, then tensor(roos_iota_I)psi=theta roos_iota_J as whole chain maps. No K-flatness or exact-products hypothesis is needed. The module exports the sheaf specialization with the original tensor wrappers as well.

proof.text: Use the specified tensor/shift isomorphism for shift -1, then the signed tensor/cone isomorphism, and finally the shifted mapping-cone map of the commuting square b. This constructs a chain map with no chosen filler.

proof.text: Project to the two cone summands. Naturality of degree-transport isomorphisms cancels the intermediate shift transports. On the cone-source summand the tensor/cone sign (-1)^p cancels the tensor/shift sign (-1)^(-p), giving the unshifted coordinate b. On the other summand only the tensor/shift sign remains, giving (-1)^p b. These are precisely the two equations of SignedCoordinates.

proof.text: Check the inclusion square by the two biproduct projections and by each total summand. The shifted coordinate of roos_iota is zero, so both composites have zero there. The other coordinate is the ordinary product inclusion; its equality is exactly the assumed whole inclusion equation for theta and b.

lean.statement:
theorem signedFiberMap_spec (A : CochainComplex (Modules R) ℤ)
    (I J : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Modules R) ℤ)
    (b : ((total R).obj A).obj (roosP I) ⟶ roosP J)
    (θ : ((total R).obj A).obj (limit I.asFunctor) ⟶ limit J.asFunctor)
    (hb : ((total R).obj A).map (roosU I) ≫ b = b ≫ roosU J)
    (hθ : ((total R).obj A).map (InjectiveTowerRoos.inclusion I) ≫ b =
      θ ≫ InjectiveTowerRoos.inclusion J) :
    SignedCoordinates A I J b (signedFiberMap R A I J b hb) ∧
      ((total R).obj A).map (roosι I) ≫ signedFiberMap R A I J b hb = θ ≫ roosι J
